items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And I loaned them to Louis Primm. I never did get them back, the Longstrong records.

ctx.x: Could you buy many records then? When you were growing up? Were you making that kind of money? Did you buy many?

Yeah, I mean at the time I used to get these old care records. You know, Longstrong and Big Spyback and a few other ones. And, you see I loaned a lot from those records. I mean, you helped a lot. And I loaned them to Louis Primm. I never did get them back, the Longstrong records. That was the end of them. He was always conniving for something. He got it in his own way. He was alright though. I remember when he used to play the cornet. And he used to play the violin. He played a good violin. When he was going to…

I never did hear him play violin. No. I don't guess he made a good record. No, he never even made a good record. Was he a hot violin player? Yeah. A straight man. Hot, he got all the way. Did they have many hot violin players there?
